name: Fikret
site: netcologne.de · Fibre and DSL provider, Cologne, Germany
headline: Turn NetCologne’s usage data into connections that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells fibre and DSL tariffs to private and business customers the same way, with the same top offers and promotions for every visitor, whether they are a household in a new fibre area or a small firm.

Once a customer logs in to their account, the tariff they use, their support calls and the offers they ignore are your strongest signal for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week, for example after a slow connection complaint, gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from logins, support contacts and tariff usage. The right offer, channel and moment for each household, tested continuously, before the customer decides to leave.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the upgrade that fits
cases.text: Next best tariff or add-on for each customer, based on what they use today. No more blanket upgrade mails to people who already have the right tariff.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep customers engaged with their account
cases.text: Personal nudges to log in, check usage and try services not yet used, across email, account and support, so each customer has a reason to stay engaged.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
